title: A projectile's path
caption: Kicked at 20 m s⁻¹ and 30°, the ball follows a parabola. Range R = u² sin 2θ / g = 35.3 m; maximum height H = u² sin²θ / 2g = 5.1 m, reached halfway.
alt: Parabolic trajectory of height against horizontal distance, peaking at 5.1 metres at 17.7 metres and landing at 35.3 metres.
description: Horizontal velocity is constant; vertical velocity changes at g, so the path is a parabola.
Maximum height: (20 sin 30°)² / (2 × 9.8) = 5.1 m at x = 17.7 m.
No air resistance; with drag the path is shorter and steeper coming down.

checks.name: maximum height 5.1 m at half the range
